title: Adi-khanda, part 1 (portion 09)
html:
The beginning of the Adi-khanda: the Lord enters Shachi's womb; Advaita Acharya worships Shachi's womb; the praises of the gods; Gaura's appearance on the full moon of Phalguna during an eclipse; the infant's form and marks; the rapture of the people of Nadia; the name Nimai, the festivals of the eighth and ninth days; the beginning of the Balya-lila

Janma-lila (The Birth)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. In this khanda first of all the appearance on earth of the transcendental Sri Gaurahari is described. He who is the original cause of all causes, Parabrahman Narayana, appeared in the womb of Shachi. As her womb grew day by day, so day by day the lustre of her body increased. Seeing the wondrous lustre of her body, all were amazed and concluded: "Surely some great personage has appeared in Shachi's womb." When six months were complete, one day Advaita Acharya Prabhu came to the house of Shachi and Jagannatha, bowed to Shachi's womb and circumambulated it; the reason for this neither Shachi nor Jagannatha could then understand. On some days Shachi-devi saw Brahma, Shiva and the other gods come before her womb, offer praise and pray to the Lord, who gives prema even to chandalas, for the love never given before; and in bliss her heart was filled with compassion for all beings. Gradually ten months were completed. Then, on the full moon of Phalguna, on the pretext of an eclipse, accompanied by the sankirtana of Hari's name, Bhagavan Gaurachandra descended to earth from the ocean of Shachi's womb; the ten directions were filled with bliss, and gods and goddesses, men and women, all longing to see the moon-like face of Shachi's son, came to Shachi's house; at that time her house became Vaikuntha. Jagannatha Mishra and the men and women of Nadia (who had come to see) were all amazed to see on the lotus feet of the child — with a lion's neck, an elephant's shoulders and a broad chest — the marks of the flag, the thunderbolt and the goad, and various superhuman marks on His other limbs; all concluded that this child was surely not human. Then are described the distribution of the eight kinds of pulses on the eighth day, the festival on the ninth, and the one-pointed love of the neighbours, men and women, for [Shachi's] son.

Raga dhanashi; disha: "Glory to Narahari and Gadadhara, the Lords of my life! Cast, O Lord, an auspicious glance upon living beings! Lord Gorachand — glory, glory!"1

জয় জয় গদাধর গৌরাঙ্গ নরহরি ।
জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দ সর্বশক্তিধারী ॥ ১ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa gadādhara gaurāṅga narahari |
jaẏa jaẏa nityānanda sarbaśaktidhārī || 1 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; gadadhara gauranga narahari — to Gadadhara, Gauranga, Narahari; nityananda — to Nityananda; sarva-shakti-dhari — bearer of all energies

1Glory, glory to Gadadhara, Gauranga and Narahari!
Glory, glory to Nityananda, the bearer of all energies!

জয় জয় অদ্বৈত-আচার্য মহেশ্বর ।
জয় জয় গৌরাঙ্গের ভক্ত মহাবর ॥ ২ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa adbaita-ācārya maheśbara |
jaẏa jaẏa gaurāṅgera bhakta mahābara || 2 ||

jaya jaya advaita-acharya maheshvara — glory to Advaita Acharya, Maheshvara; jaya jaya gaurangera bhakta mahavara — glory to the great devotees of Gauranga

2Glory, glory to Advaita Acharya, Maheshvara!
Glory, glory to the great devotees of Gauranga!

সভার চরণধূলি মস্তকে ধরিয়া ।
আদিখণ্ড-কথা কহি শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ৩ ॥

sabhāra caraṇadhūli mastake dhariẏā |
ādikhaṇḍa-kathā kahi śuna mana diẏā || 3 ||

sabhara charana-dhuli — the dust of the feet of all; mastake dhariya — placing on my head; adikhanda-katha kahi — I tell the story of the Adi-khanda; shuna mana diya — listen attentively

3Placing on my head the dust of the feet of all,
I tell the story of the Adi-khanda — listen attentively.

সর্ব নিজজন যবে জনম লভিল ।
সাজ সাজ বলি শব্দ ঘোষণা পড়িল ॥ ৪ ॥

sarba nijajana yabe janama labhila |
sāja sāja bali śabda ghoṣaṇā paṛila || 4 ||

sarva nijajana — all His own; yabe janama labhila — when they took birth; saja saja bali — "make ready, make ready!"; shabda ghoshana padila — the cry was proclaimed

4When all His own had taken birth,
the cry rang out: "Make ready, make ready!"

পৃথিবী চলিব আর নাহিক বিলম্ব ।
আপনি ঠাকুর শচীগর্ভে অবলম্ব ॥ ৫ ॥

pṛthibī caliba āra nāhika bilamba |
āpani ṭhākura śacīgarbhe abalamba || 5 ||

prithivi chaliba — I go to earth; ara nahika vilamba — no more delay; apani thakura — the Lord Himself; shachi-garbhe avalamba — took shelter in Shachi's womb

5"I go to earth, there must be no more delay" —
and the Lord Himself took shelter in Shachi's womb.

জয় জয় শব্দ হৈল ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিয়া ।
দেব নাগ নর দেখে প্রেমাবিষ্ট হঞা ॥ ৬ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa śabda haila brahmāṇḍa bhariẏā |
deba nāga nara dekhe premābiṣṭa hañā || 6 ||

jaya jaya shabda haila — cries of "jaya, jaya" arose; brahmanda bhariya — filling the universe; deva naga nara dekhe — gods, nagas and men look on; premavishta hana — overcome with prema

6Cries of "Jaya, jaya!" filled the universe;
gods, nagas and men look on, overcome with prema.

কেহো যারে বোলে জ্যোতির্ময় সনাতন ।
কেহো যারে বোলে সূক্ষ্ম স্থূল নারায়ণ ॥ ৭ ॥

keho yāre bole jyotirmaẏa sanātana |
keho yāre bole sūkṣma sthūla nārāẏaṇa || 7 ||

keho yare bole — whom some call; jyotirmaya sanatana — the eternal Effulgence; keho yare bole — whom others call; sukshma sthula narayana — Narayana, subtle and gross

7He whom some call the eternal Effulgence,
whom others call Narayana, subtle and gross,

কেহো যারে বোলে স্থূল সূক্ষ্ম পরব্রহ্ম ।
সে জন করিল শচীগর্ভে অবলম্ব ॥ ৮ ॥

keho yāre bole sthūla sūkṣma parabrahma |
se jana karila śacīgarbhe abalamba || 8 ||

keho yare bole — whom others call; sthula sukshma parabrahma — Parabrahman, gross and subtle; se jana — He; karila shachi-garbhe avalamba — took shelter in Shachi's womb

8whom others call Parabrahman, gross and subtle —
He took shelter in Shachi's womb.

তেজোময় বায়ুরূপ গর্ভ বাঢ়ে নিতি ।
দেখিয়া ত সর্বলোকের বাঢ়য়ে পীরিতি ॥ ৯ ॥

tejomaẏa bāẏurūpa garbha bāṛhe niti |
dekhiẏā ta sarbalokera bāṛhaẏe pīriti || 9 ||

tejomaya — radiant; vayu-rupa — airlike; garbha badhe niti — the burden of the womb grows daily; dekhiya ta — seeing it; sarvalokera badhaye piriti — the love of all people grows

9Radiant, airlike,2 the burden of the womb grows daily;
seeing it, the love of all people grows.

এক দুই তিন চারি পাঁচ ছয় মাসে ।
শচীর উদরে মহানন্দ পরকাশে ॥ ১০ ॥

eka dui tina cāri pāṁca chaẏa māse |
śacīra udare mahānanda parakāśe || 10 ||

eka dui tina chari pancha chhaya mase — one, two, three, four, five, six months; shachira udare — in Shachi's womb; mahananda parakashe — great bliss reveals itself

10One, two, three, four, five, six months —
in Shachi's womb great bliss reveals itself.

দিনে দিনে তেজঃ বাঢ়ে শচীর শরীরে ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক হরিষ অন্তরে ॥ ১১ ॥

dine dine tejaḥ bāṛhe śacīra śarīre |
dekhiẏā sakala loka hariṣa antare || 11 ||

dine dine — day by day; tejah badhe shachira sharire — the radiance of Shachi's body grows; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing it, all people; harisha antare — rejoice at heart

11Day by day the radiance of Shachi's body grows;
seeing it, all the people rejoice at heart.

না জানিয়ে কোন জন আইল শচীর ঘরে ।
ঘরে ঘরে এই মনে সভাই বিচারে ॥ ১২ ॥

nā jāniẏe kona jana āila śacīra ghare |
ghare ghare ei mane sabhāi bicāre || 12 ||

na janiye — we do not know; kona jana aila shachira ghare — who has come into Shachi's house; ghare ghare — in every house; ei mane sabhai vichare — so all ponder

12"We do not know who has come into Shachi's house" —
so in every house all are pondering.

ছয় মাস পূর্ণ হৈলে শচীর উদর ।
অঙ্গের ছটায় ঝলমল করে ঘর ॥ ১৩ ॥

chaẏa māsa pūrṇa haile śacīra udara |
aṅgera chaṭāẏa jhalamala kare ghara || 13 ||

chhaya masa purna haile — when six months were complete; shachira udara — of Shachi's womb; angera chhataya — with the splendour of her body; jhalamala kare ghara — the house shone

13When six months of Shachi's womb were complete,
the house shone with the splendour of her body.

হেনই সময়ে এক অদ্ভুত কথা ।
আচম্বিতে অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আইলা তথা ॥ ১৪ ॥

henai samaẏe eka adbhuta kathā |
ācambite adbaita-ācārya āilā tathā || 14 ||

henai samaye — at that time; eka adbhuta katha — a wondrous event; achambite — suddenly; advaita-acharya aila tatha — Advaita Acharya came there

14At that time a wondrous thing took place:
suddenly Advaita Acharya came there.

ঘরে বসি আছে জগন্নাথ দ্বিজবর্য ।
সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা দেখি অদ্বৈত-আচার্য ॥ ১৫ ॥

ghare basi āche jagannātha dbijabarya |
sambhrame uṭhilā dekhi adbaita-ācārya || 15 ||

ghare basi achhe — sat in the house; jagannatha dvijavarya — Jagannatha, best of the twice-born; sambhrame uthila — rose respectfully; dekhi advaita-acharya — seeing Advaita Acharya

15In the house sat Jagannatha, best of the twice-born;
seeing Advaita Acharya, he rose respectfully.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য গোসাঞি সর্বগুণধাম ।
ত্রিজগতে ধন্য তাঁর নাহিক উপাম ॥ ১৬ ॥

adbaita-ācārya gosāñi sarbaguṇadhāma |
trijagate dhanya tāṁra nāhika upāma || 16 ||

advaita-acharya gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; sarva-guna-dhama — abode of all virtues; trijagate dhanya — blessed in the three worlds; tanra nahika upama — He has no equal

16Advaita Acharya Gosani is the abode of all virtues,
blessed in the three worlds, without equal.

দেখি মিশ্র পুরন্দর বড়ই সম্ভ্রমে ।
বসিতে আসন আনি দিলেন আপনে ॥ ১৭ ॥

dekhi miśra purandara baṛai sambhrame |
basite āsana āni dilena āpane || 17 ||

dekhi — seeing; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; badai sambhrame — with great respect; basite asana ani — bringing a seat to sit on; dilena apane — himself offered

17Seeing Him, Mishra Purandara with great respect
himself brought a seat for Him to sit on,

চরণের ধূলি লৈল মস্তক উপর ।
সম্ভ্রমে আচার্য কৈল বিনয় বিস্তর ॥ ১৮ ॥

caraṇera dhūli laila mastaka upara |
sambhrame ācārya kaila binaẏa bistara || 18 ||

charanera dhuli laila — took the dust of the feet; mastaka upara — upon his head; sambhrame — abashed; acharya kaila vinaya vistara — the Acharya showed much humility

18and placed the dust of His feet on his head;
the Acharya, abashed, showed much humility.

পাদপ্রক্ষালনে জল দিল শচীদেবী ।
শচী দেখি সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা অনুরাগী ॥ ১৯ ॥

pādaprakṣālane jala dila śacīdebī |
śacī dekhi sambhrame uṭhilā anurāgī || 19 ||

pada-prakshalane — for washing the feet; jala dila shachidevi — Shachi-devi gave water; shachi dekhi — seeing Shachi; sambhrame uthila anuragi — full of love, He rose respectfully

19Shachi-devi gave water to wash His feet;
seeing Shachi, He, full of love, rose respectfully.

অনুরাগে রাঙ্গা দুই কমললোচন ।
বাষ্প ঝলমল আঁখি অরুণ বদন ॥ ২০ ॥

anurāge rāṅgā dui kamalalocana |
bāṣpa jhalamala āṁkhi aruṇa badana || 20 ||

anurage — with love; ranga dui kamala-lochana — the two lotus eyes red; bashpa jhalamala ankhi — eyes brimming with tears; aruna vadana — face flushed

20With love His two lotus eyes grew red,
His eyes brimmed with tears, His face was flushed,

সকম্প অধর গদগদ কণ্ঠস্বর ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ করে টলমল ॥ ২১ ॥

sakampa adhara gadagada kaṇṭhasbara |
dharite nā pāre aṅga kare ṭalamala || 21 ||

sakampa adhara — trembling lips; gadgada kanthasvara — faltering voice; dharite na pare anga — cannot hold His body; kare talamala — staggers

21His lips trembled, His voice faltered;
He could not hold His body steady — He staggered.

শচী প্রদক্ষিণ করি করে পরণাম ।
চমকিত শচীদেবী দেখি অবিধান ॥ ২২ ॥

śacī pradakṣiṇa kari kare paraṇāma |
camakita śacīdebī dekhi abidhāna || 22 ||

shachi pradakshina kari — circumambulating Shachi; kare paranama — bows; chamakita shachidevi — Shachi-devi started; dekhi avidhana — seeing the breach of custom

22Circumambulating Shachi, He bows to her;
Shachi-devi started, seeing this breach of custom.3

জগন্নাথ সসন্দেহ শচী সবিস্মিতা ।
কি কর কি কর বোলে হৃদয়ে দুঃখিতা ॥ ২৩ ॥

jagannātha sasandeha śacī sabismitā |
ki kara ki kara bole hṛdaẏe duḥkhitā || 23 ||

jagannatha sasandeha — Jagannatha perplexed; shachi savismita — Shachi amazed; ki kara ki kara bole — "what are you doing?" she says; hridaye duhkhita — pained at heart

23Jagannatha is perplexed, Shachi amazed:
"What are you doing, what are you doing?" she says, pained at heart.

জগন্নাথ বোলে শুন আচার্য গোসাঞি ।
তোমার চরিত্র কেহো বুঝিবারে নাঞি ॥ ২৪ ॥

jagannātha bole śuna ācārya gosāñi |
tomāra caritra keho bujhibāre nāñi || 24 ||

jagannatha bole — Jagannatha says; shuna acharya gosani — listen, Acharya Gosani; tomara charitra — Your conduct; keho bujhibare nani — no one can understand

24Jagannatha says: "Listen, Acharya Gosani:
no one can understand Your conduct.

দয়া করি কহ যদি ঘুচাও সন্দেহ ।
নহে বা এ চিন্তা-অগ্নি পোড়াইবে দেহ ॥ ২৫ ॥

daẏā kari kaha yadi ghucāo sandeha |
nahe bā e cintā-agni poṛāibe deha || 25 ||

daya kari kaha — be kind and tell; yadi ghuchao sandeha — dispel the doubt; nahe va — or else; e chinta-agni podaibe deha — this fire of anxiety will burn the body

25Be kind and tell us, dispel our doubt,
or else the fire of this anxiety will burn my body."

আচার্য কহিল শুন মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
জানিবে সকল পাছে কহিল উত্তর ॥ ২৬ ॥

ācārya kahila śuna miśra purandara |
jānibe sakala pāche kahila uttara || 26 ||

acharya kahila — the Acharya said; shuna mishra purandara — listen, Mishra Purandara; janibe sakala pachhe — later you will know all; kahila uttara — He answered

26The Acharya said: "Listen, Mishra Purandara:
later you will know everything" — such was His answer.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ জানিঞা সন্দর্ভ ।
গন্ধ-চন্দনেতে লেপে শচীর শ্রীগর্ভ ॥ ২৭ ॥

pulakita saba aṅga jāniñā sandarbha |
gandha-candanete lepe śacīra śrīgarbha || 27 ||

pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrilling; janina sandarbha — knowing the matter; gandha-chandanete lepe — anoints with fragrant sandal; shachira shri-garbha — Shachi's holy womb

27His whole body thrilled: knowing the matter,
He anointed Shachi's holy womb with fragrant sandal,

সাত প্রদক্ষিণ করি করে পরণাম ।
না কিছু কহিলা গেলা আপনার স্থান ॥ ২৮ ॥

sāta pradakṣiṇa kari kare paraṇāma |
nā kichu kahilā gelā āpanāra sthāna || 28 ||

sata pradakshina kari — circumambulating seven times; kare paranama — bows; na kichhu kahila — saying nothing; gela apanara sthana — went to His own place

28circumambulated [her] seven times, bowed down,
and without saying anything went to His own place.

এথা শচী জগন্নাথ মনে অনুমানে ।
মোর গর্ভবন্দনা করিলা কি কারণে ॥ ২৯ ॥

ethā śacī jagannātha mane anumāne |
mora garbhabandanā karilā ki kāraṇe || 29 ||

etha — here; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; mane anumane — ponder in their minds; mora garbha-vandana — worship of my womb; karila ki karane — why did He do

29Here Shachi and Jagannatha ponder:
"Why did He worship my womb?"

আচার্য-গোসাঞি কৈল গর্ভের বন্দনা ।
শতগুণ তেজ শচী পাসরে আপনা ॥ ৩০ ॥

ācārya-gosāñi kaila garbhera bandanā |
śataguṇa teja śacī pāsare āpanā || 30 ||

acharya-gosani kaila — Acharya Gosani performed; garbhera vandana — worship of the womb; shataguna teja — a hundredfold radiance; shachi pasare apana — Shachi forgets herself

30Acharya Gosani worshipped the womb —
and Shachi's radiance grew a hundredfold; she forgets herself.

সব সুখময় দেখে না দেখয়ে দুঃখ ।
সব দেবগণ দেখে আপনা-সম্মুখ ॥ ৩১ ॥

saba sukhamaẏa dekhe nā dekhaẏe duḥkha |
saba debagaṇa dekhe āpanā-sammukha || 31 ||

saba sukhamaya dekhe — sees all as joy; na dekhaye duhkha — sees no sorrow; saba devagana dekhe — sees all the gods; apana-sammukha — before her

31She sees all as joy, sees no sorrow;
she sees all the gods before her.

ব্রহ্মা শিব সনকাদি যত দেবগণ ।
উদর সম্মুখ করি করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৩২ ॥

brahmā śiba sanakādi yata debagaṇa |
udara sammukha kari karaẏe stabana || 32 ||

brahma shiva sanakadi — Brahma, Shiva, Sanaka and the rest; yata devagana — all the gods; udara sammukha kari — facing the womb; karaye stavana — offer praise

32Brahma, Shiva, Sanaka and the others — all the gods,
facing her womb, offer praise:

জয় জয় অনন্ত অদ্বৈত সনাতন ।
জয়াচ্যুতানন্দ নিত্যানন্দ জনার্দন ॥ ৩৩ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa ananta adbaita sanātana |
jaẏācyutānanda nityānanda janārdana || 33 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; ananta advaita sanatana — to the Infinite, Non-dual, Eternal; jaya achyutananda — glory to the Bliss of Achyuta; nityananda — Eternal Bliss; janardana — Janardana

33"Glory, glory to the Infinite, the Non-dual, the Eternal!
Glory to the Bliss of Achyuta, the Eternal Bliss, Janardana!4

জয় সত্ত্ব রজস্তম প্রকৃতির পর ।
জয় মহাবিষ্ণু কারণ-সমুদ্র-ভিতর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

jaẏa sattba rajastama prakṛtira para |
jaẏa mahābiṣṇu kāraṇa-samudra-bhitara || 34 ||

jaya — glory; sattva rajas-tama prakritira para — to Him beyond prakriti — sattva, rajas, tamas; jaya mahavishnu — glory to Maha-Vishnu; karana-samudra-bhitara — within the Causal Ocean

34Glory to Him who is beyond prakriti — sattva, rajas and tamas!
Glory to Maha-Vishnu [abiding] in the Causal Ocean!

জয় পরব্যোমনাথ মহিমা-বিস্তার ।
জয় সত্ত্ব পরসত্ত্ব বিশুদ্ধসত্ত্বাকার ॥ ৩৫ ॥

jaẏa parabyomanātha mahimā-bistāra |
jaẏa sattba parasattba biśuddhasattbākāra || 35 ||

jaya paravyoma-natha — glory to the Lord of Paravyoma; mahima-vistara — whose greatness is boundless; jaya sattva parasattva — glory to sattva, the highest sattva; vishuddha-sattvakara — whose form is pure sattva

35Glory to the Lord of Paravyoma, whose greatness is boundless!
Glory to [Him who is] sattva, the highest sattva, whose form is pure sattva!

জয় গোলোকের পতি রাধার নাগর ।
জয় জয় অনন্ত-বৈকুণ্ঠ-অধীশ্বর ॥ ৩৬ ॥

jaẏa golokera pati rādhāra nāgara |
jaẏa jaẏa ananta-baikuṇṭha-adhīśbara || 36 ||

jaya golokera pati — glory to the Lord of Goloka; radhara nagara — beloved of Radha; jaya jaya — glory, glory; ananta-vaikuntha-adhishvara — supreme Lord of the countless Vaikunthas

36Glory to the Lord of Goloka, the beloved of Radha!
Glory, glory to the supreme Lord of the countless Vaikunthas!

জয় জয় নিশ্চিন্ত ধীরললিত ।
জয় জয় সর্বমনোহর নন্দসুত ॥ ৩৭ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa niścinta dhīralalita |
jaẏa jaẏa sarbamanohara nandasuta || 37 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; nishchinta — to the carefree; dhira-lalita — playful hero; sarva-manohara — all-enchanting; nanda-suta — son of Nanda

37Glory, glory to the carefree, playful hero (dhira-lalita)!
Glory, glory to the all-enchanting son of Nanda!

এবে কলিযুগে শচীগর্ভেতে প্রকাশ ।
আপনে ভুঞ্জিতে আইলা আপন-বিলাস ॥ ৩৮ ॥

ebe kaliyuge śacīgarbhete prakāśa |
āpane bhuñjite āilā āpana-bilāsa || 38 ||

ebe kali-yuge — now in the Kali-yuga; shachi-garbhete prakasha — appearing in Shachi's womb; apane bhunjite — to taste Yourself; aila apana-vilasa — You came, Your own play

38Now, in the Kali-yuga, appearing in Shachi's womb,
You have come to taste Your own play Yourself.

জয় জয় পরানন্দ-দাতা এই প্রভু ।
এ হেন করুণা আর নাহি হয় কভু ॥ ৩৯ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa parānanda-dātā ei prabhu |
e hena karuṇā āra nāhi haẏa kabhu || 39 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; parananda-data — to the giver of supreme bliss; ei prabhu — this Lord; e hena karuna — such mercy; ara nahi haya kabhu — never has been

39Glory, glory to this Lord, the giver of supreme bliss!
Such mercy has never been.

আপনি আপন-দাতা হৈলা কলিকালে ।
পাত্রাপাত্র-বিচার না হৈব গদাধরে ॥ ৪০ ॥

āpani āpana-dātā hailā kalikāle |
pātrāpātra-bicāra nā haiba gadādhare || 40 ||

apani apana-data — You, the giver of Yourself; haila kalikale — have become in the age of Kali; patrapatra-vichara — judging of worthy and unworthy; na haiba gadadhare — there will be none with Gadadhara

40In the age of Kali You have become the giver of Yourself:
with Gadadhara there will be no judging of worthy and unworthy.5

যে প্রেম যাচিঞা করোঁ মোরা সব দেবে ।
না পাইলুঁ লবলেশ গন্ধ-অনুভবে ॥ ৪১ ॥

ye prema yāciñā karoṁ morā saba debe |
nā pāiluṁ labaleśa gandha-anubhabe || 41 ||

ye prema — that prema; yachina karon mora saba deve — which we, all the gods, beg for; na pailun — we did not obtain; laba-lesha — a particle; gandha-anubhave — nor a sense of its fragrance

41That prema for which we, all the gods, beg
we have not obtained — not a particle, not even its fragrance.

সে প্রেম মধুর রস আপনি খাইয়া ।
ভুঞ্জাইবে আচণ্ডালে দোষ না দেখিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

se prema madhura rasa āpani khāiẏā |
bhuñjāibe ācaṇḍāle doṣa nā dekhiẏā || 42 ||

se prema madhura rasa — that prema, the sweet rasa; apani khaiya — tasting Yourself; bhunjaibe achandale — You will give to taste down to the chandala; dosha na dekhiya — not looking at faults

42That prema, that sweet rasa, You will taste Yourself
and give to all to taste, down to the chandala, not looking at faults.

তুয়া প্রেম-লব-লেশ মোরা যেন পাই ।
তোর সঙ্গে রাধাকৃষ্ণ-গুণ যেন গাই ॥ ৪৩ ॥

tuẏā prema-laba-leśa morā yena pāi |
tora saṅge rādhākṛṣṇa-guṇa yena gāi || 43 ||

tuya prema-laba-lesha — a particle of Your prema; mora yena pai — may we obtain; tora sange — with You; radha-krishna-guna yena gai — may we sing the virtues of Radha and Krishna

43May we too obtain a particle of Your prema,
may we sing with You the virtues of Radha and Krishna.

জয় জয় সঙ্কীর্তনদাতা গৌরহরি ।
ইহা বলি দেবগণ প্রদক্ষিণ করি ॥ ৪৪ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa saṅkīrtanadātā gaurahari |
ihā bali debagaṇa pradakṣiṇa kari || 44 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; sankirtana-data gaurahari — to Gaurahari, giver of sankirtana; iha bali — so saying; devagana pradakshina kari — the gods circumambulate

44Glory, glory to Gaurahari, the giver of sankirtana!"
So saying, the gods circumambulate [her].

চারিমুখে ব্রহ্মা করে বহুবিধ স্তুতি ।
তরাসিল শচীদেবী চমকিত-মতি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

cārimukhe brahmā kare bahubidha stuti |
tarāsila śacīdebī camakita-mati || 45 ||

chari-mukhe — with four mouths; brahma kare bahuvidha stuti — Brahma offers many praises; tarasila shachidevi — Shachi-devi grew afraid; chamakita-mati — her mind startled

45With four mouths Brahma offers many kinds of praise;
Shachi-devi grew afraid, her mind startled.

সর্বজীবে দয়া ভেল শচীর অন্তরে ।
আত্মজ্ঞানে দয়া করে নাহি ভিন্ন পরে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

sarbajībe daẏā bhela śacīra antare |
ātmajñāne daẏā kare nāhi bhinna pare || 46 ||

sarvajive daya bhela — compassion for all beings arose; shachira antare — in Shachi's heart; atma-jnane daya kare — she is kind as to herself; nahi bhinna pare — no distinction of own and other

46Shachi's heart was filled with compassion for all beings:
she is kind [to all] as to herself, not distinguishing her own from others.

দশ মাস পূর্ণ ভেল গর্ভ দিশে দিশে ।
আপনা পাসরে দেবী মনের হরিষে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

daśa māsa pūrṇa bhela garbha diśe diśe |
āpanā pāsare debī manera hariṣe || 47 ||

dasha masa purna bhela garbha — ten months of pregnancy were complete; dishe dishe — on every side; apana pasare devi — the goddess forgets herself; manera harishe — with the joy of her heart

47Ten months of the pregnancy were complete; [joy] on every side —
the goddess forgets herself with the joy of her heart.

শুভদিন শুভক্ষণ পূর্ণিমার তিথি ।
ফাল্গুনের শুভনিশি হিমকর-দ্যুতি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

śubhadina śubhakṣaṇa pūrṇimāra tithi |
phālgunera śubhaniśi himakara-dyuti || 48 ||

shubha-dina shubha-kshana — an auspicious day, an auspicious hour; purnimara tithi — the lunar day of the full moon; phalgunera shubha-nishi — the auspicious night of Phalguna; himakara-dyuti — the radiance of the moon

48An auspicious day, an auspicious hour, the lunar day of the full moon,
the auspicious night of Phalguna, the radiance of the moon.

রাহু চন্দ্র গরাসয়ে অদ্ভুত বেলে ।
উঠিল চৌদিগ ভরি হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

rāhu candra garāsaẏe adbhuta bele |
uṭhila caudiga bhari hari hari bole || 49 ||

rahu chandra garasaye — Rahu swallows the moon; adbhuta vele — at a wondrous hour; uthila chaudiga bhari — arose, filling all around; hari hari bole — cries of "Hari, Hari"

49At a wondrous hour Rahu swallows the moon —
and on every side arose the cry: "Hari, Hari!"6

চৌদিগ ভরিল আর দিব্য চারু গন্ধে ।
পরসন্ন দশদিগ বায়ু মন্দ মন্দে ॥ ৫০ ॥

caudiga bharila āra dibya cāru gandhe |
parasanna daśadiga bāẏu manda mande || 50 ||

chaudiga bharila ara — all around was filled; divya charu gandhe — with divine lovely fragrance; parasanna dashadiga — the ten directions grew bright; vayu manda mande — the breeze soft and gentle

50All around was filled with a divine, lovely fragrance;
the ten directions grew bright, the breeze blew soft and gentle.

ষড়ঋতু উদয় ভৈ গেল সেই কালে ।
প্রভু-শুভজন্ম পৃথিবীতে হেন বেলে ॥ ৫১ ॥

ṣaṛaṛtu udaẏa bhai gela sei kāle |
prabhu-śubhajanma pṛthibīte hena bele || 51 ||

shad-ritu udaya bhai gela — the six seasons appeared; sei kale — at that time; prabhu-shubha-janma — the Lord's auspicious birth; prithivite hena vele — on earth at such an hour

51At that time all six seasons appeared at once —
at such an hour the Lord took His auspicious birth on earth.

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ দিব্য যানে চাহে ।
গৌর-অঙ্গ দেখিবারে অনুরাগে ধাহে ॥ ৫২ ॥

antarīkṣe debagaṇa dibya yāne cāhe |
gaura-aṅga dekhibāre anurāge dhāhe || 52 ||

antarikshe devagana — in the sky the gods; divya yane chahe — look from celestial cars; gaura-anga dekhibare — to see Gaura's body; anurage dhahe — run in love

52In the sky the gods look on from their celestial cars,
running in love to see the body of Gaura.

একমাত্র শুনি ধ্বনি হরি হরি বোল ।
জন্মমাত্র প্রকাশ করিল প্রভু মোর ॥ ৫৩ ॥

ekamātra śuni dhbani hari hari bola |
janmamātra prakāśa karila prabhu mora || 53 ||

ekamatra shuni dhvani — only one sound is heard; hari hari bola — "Haribol, Haribol"; janma-matra — the moment He was born; prakasha karila prabhu mora — my Lord revealed

53Only one sound is heard: "Haribol, Haribol!" —
this my Lord revealed the moment He was born.

শচীর সদনে ভেল বৈকুণ্ঠ-সম্পদ ।
আনন্দে বিভোল শচী বোলে গদগদ ॥ ৫৪ ॥

śacīra sadane bhela baikuṇṭha-sampada |
ānande bibhola śacī bole gadagada || 54 ||

shachira sadane — in Shachi's house; bhela vaikuntha-sampada — the riches of Vaikuntha appeared; anande vibhola shachi — Shachi beside herself with bliss; bole gadgada — speaks falteringly

54In Shachi's house the riches of Vaikuntha appeared;7
beside herself with bliss, Shachi speaks in a faltering voice;

জগন্নাথ-পণ্ডিতেরে ডাকে হাথসানে ।
জনম সফল দেখ পুত্রের বয়ানে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

jagannātha-paṇḍitere ḍāke hāthasāne |
janama saphala dekha putrera baẏāne || 55 ||

jagannatha-panditere — Jagannatha Pandita; dake hathasane — calls with a gesture; janama saphala — life has borne fruit; dekha putrera bayane — look at the son's face

55with a gesture she calls Jagannatha Pandita:
"Our life has borne fruit — look at our son's face!"

পুরনারীগণ জয় জয় দেই সুখে ।
আনন্দে বিভোর সভে দেখিয়া বালকে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

puranārīgaṇa jaẏa jaẏa dei sukhe |
ānande bibhora sabhe dekhiẏā bālake || 56 ||

puranarigana — the women of the town; jaya jaya dei sukhe — joyfully cry "jaya, jaya"; anande vibhora sabhe — all beside themselves with bliss; dekhiya balake — seeing the child

56The women of the town joyfully cry "Jaya, jaya!",
all beside themselves with bliss at the sight of the child.

বেদ-দেব-নাগকন্যা সভাই আইলা ।
দেখিয়া গৌরাঙ্গ জয় জয় ধ্বনি কৈলা ॥ ৫৭ ॥

beda-deba-nāgakanyā sabhāi āilā |
dekhiẏā gaurāṅga jaẏa jaẏa dhbani kailā || 57 ||

veda-deva-naga-kanya — [wives] of sages, goddesses and naga maidens; sabhai aila — all came; dekhiya gauranga — seeing Gauranga; jaya jaya dhvani kaila — raised the cry "jaya, jaya"

57The wives of sages, goddesses and naga maidens all came —
seeing Gauranga, they raised the cry "Jaya, jaya!"

গৌর-গরিমা-গন্ধে ভরিল ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ।
প্রতি অঙ্গ রসরাশি অমিয়া অখণ্ড ॥ ৫৮ ॥

gaura-garimā-gandhe bharila brahmāṇḍa |
prati aṅga rasarāśi amiẏā akhaṇḍa || 58 ||

gaura-garima-gandhe — with the fragrance of Gaura's majesty; bharila brahmanda — the universe was filled; prati anga rasa-rashi — each limb a treasury of rasa; amiya akhanda — unbroken nectar

58The fragrance of Gaura's majesty filled the universe;
each of His limbs is a treasury of rasa, unbroken nectar.

দেখিতে দেখিতে সভার জুড়াইল নয়ান ।
সভার মনে হৈল ব্রজ-নাগরীর প্রাণ ॥ ৫৯ ॥

dekhite dekhite sabhāra juṛāila naẏāna |
sabhāra mane haila braja-nāgarīra prāṇa || 59 ||

dekhite dekhite — gazing and gazing; sabhara judaila nayana — the eyes of all were soothed; sabhara mane haila — it seemed to all; vraja-nagarira prana — [this is] the life of the nagaris of Vraja

59Gazing and gazing, all their eyes were soothed;
to all it seemed: this is the life of the nagaris of Vraja.

এ হেন বালক কভু দেখি নাহি শুনি ।
ইহারে দেখিয়া হিয়া করয়ে কি জানি ॥ ৬০ ॥

e hena bālaka kabhu dekhi nāhi śuni |
ihāre dekhiẏā hiẏā karaẏe ki jāni || 60 ||

e hena balaka — such a child; kabhu dekhi nahi shuni — never seen nor heard of; ihare dekhiya — looking at Him; hiya karaye ki jani — the heart does we know not what

60"Such a child we have never seen or heard of;
looking at Him, the heart does — we know not what!

মানুষের হেন চিহ্ন না দেখিয়ে কভু ।
দিব্য বিলাসিনী বোলে জানিব ইহা পাছু ॥ ৬১ ॥

mānuṣera hena cihna nā dekhiẏe kabhu |
dibya bilāsinī bole jāniba ihā pāchu || 61 ||

manushera hena chihna — such marks in human beings; na dekhiye kabhu — we have never seen; divya vilasini bole — say the celestial beauties; janiba iha pachhu — later we shall know

61Such marks we have never seen in a human being,"
say the celestial beauties; "later we shall know [who He is]."

জগন্নাথ বিভোল দেখিয়া পুত্রমুখ ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তাঁর অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ৬২ ॥

jagannātha bibhola dekhiẏā putramukha |
brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāṁra antara-kautuka || 62 ||

jagannatha vibhola — Jagannatha beside himself; dekhiya putra-mukha — looking at the son's face; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain; tanra antara-kautuka — the delight of his heart

62Jagannatha is beside himself, looking at his son's face:
the universe cannot contain the delight of his heart.

কত চান্দ-উদয় দেখিয়া মুখখানি ।
প্রফুল্ল কমলদল বয়ান বাখানি ॥ ৬৩ ॥

kata cānda-udaẏa dekhiẏā mukhakhāni |
praphulla kamaladala baẏāna bākhāni || 63 ||

kata chanda-udaya — how many moons rising; dekhiya mukhakhani — seeing the little face; praphulla kamala-dala — a blossoming lotus; bayana bakhani — the face is described

63How many moons are rising — so looks His little face!
His face is likened to a blossoming lotus.

উন্নত নাসিকা তিলকুসুম জিনিঞা ।
ঝলমল গোরা-অঙ্গ-কিরণ অমিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

unnata nāsikā tilakusuma jiniñā |
jhalamala gorā-aṅga-kiraṇa amiẏā || 64 ||

unnata nasika — a high nose; tila-kusuma jinina — surpassing the sesame flower; jhalamala — sparkles; gora-anga-kirana amiya — the radiance of Gora's body, nectar

64His high nose surpasses the sesame flower,
the radiance of Gora's body sparkles — nectar.

অধর অরুণ আর চারু গণ্ড-দ্যুতি ।
সুন্দর চিবুক দেখি উঠয়ে পীরিতি ॥ ৬৫ ॥

adhara aruṇa āra cāru gaṇḍa-dyuti |
sundara cibuka dekhi uṭhaẏe pīriti || 65 ||

adhara aruna — lips red; ara charu ganda-dyuti — and lovely shining cheeks; sundara chibuka dekhi — seeing the beautiful chin; uthaye piriti — love wells up

65His lips are red, His cheeks lovely and shining;
seeing His beautiful chin, love wells up.

সিংহগ্রীব গজস্কন্ধ বিশাল হৃদয় ।
আজানুলম্বিত ভুজ তনু রসময় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

siṃhagrība gajaskandha biśāla hṛdaẏa |
ājānulambita bhuja tanu rasamaẏa || 66 ||

simha-griva — a lion's neck; gaja-skandha — an elephant's shoulders; vishala hridaya — a broad chest; ajanu-lambita bhuja — arms reaching the knees; tanu rasamaya — a body full of rasa

66A lion's neck, an elephant's shoulders, a broad chest,
arms reaching to the knees, a body full of rasa.

বিশাল নিতম্ব ঊরু কদলীর যেন ।
অরুণ-কমলদল দুখানি চরণ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

biśāla nitamba ūru kadalīra yena |
aruṇa-kamaladala dukhāni caraṇa || 67 ||

vishala nitamba — broad hips; uru kadalira yena — thighs like plantain stems; aruna-kamala-dala — petals of a red lotus; dukhani charana — the two feet

67Broad hips, thighs like plantain stems,
two feet like petals of a red lotus.

ধ্বজ বজ্র অঙ্কুশ সে পঙ্কজ-পদতলে ।
রথ ছত্র চামর স্বস্তিক জম্বুফলে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

dhbaja bajra aṅkuśa se paṅkaja-padatale |
ratha chatra cāmara sbastika jambuphale || 68 ||

dhvaja vajra ankusha — flag, thunderbolt, goad; se pankaja-padatale — on the lotus soles; ratha chhatra chamara — chariot, umbrella, chamara; svastika jambu-phale — svastika, jambu fruit

68On the lotus soles — the flag, the thunderbolt, the goad,
the chariot, the umbrella, the chamara, the svastika, the jambu fruit,

ঊর্ধ্বরেখা ত্রিকোণ কুঞ্জর-কুম্ভবরে ।
সব অপরূপ রূপ অমিয়া উগরে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

ūrdhbarekhā trikoṇa kuñjara-kumbhabare |
saba aparūpa rūpa amiẏā ugare || 69 ||

urdhva-rekha — the upward line; trikona — the triangle; kunjara-kumbha-bare — the elephant's kumbha; saba aparupa rupa — the whole wondrous form; amiya ugare — pours out nectar

69the upward line, the triangle, the elephant's kumbha8 —
this whole wondrous form pours out nectar.

হেন অপরূপ রূপ পৃথিবীর মাঝে ।
মহারাজ-রাজাধিক লক্ষণ বিরাজে ॥ ৭০ ॥

hena aparūpa rūpa pṛthibīra mājhe |
mahārāja-rājādhika lakṣaṇa birāje || 70 ||

hena aparupa rupa — in such a wondrous form; prithivira majhe — on the earth; maharaja-rajadhika — surpassing great kings; lakshana viraje — marks shine

70In such a wondrous form upon the earth
shine marks surpassing [those of] great kings.

ইন্দ্র চন্দ্র গন্ধর্ব কিন্নর দেবগণ ।
পৃথিবী আইলা কিবা কৌতুক কারণ ॥ ৭১ ॥

indra candra gandharba kinnara debagaṇa |
pṛthibī āilā kibā kautuka kāraṇa || 71 ||

indra chandra gandharva kinnara devagana — Indra, Chandra, gandharvas, kinnaras and gods; prithivi aila — came to earth; kiba kautuka karana — what a joyous wonder

71Indra, Chandra, gandharvas, kinnaras and gods
came to earth — what a joyous wonder!

নয়নে লাগিল সভার অমিয়া-অঞ্জন ।
চির-অনুরাগে যেন প্রিয়-দরশন ॥ ৭২ ॥

naẏane lāgila sabhāra amiẏā-añjana |
cira-anurāge yena priẏa-daraśana || 72 ||

nayane lagila sabhara — the eyes of all were touched; amiya-anjana — with a salve of nectar; chira-anurage — after long love; yena priya-darashana — as if seeing the beloved

72The eyes of all seemed anointed with a salve of nectar —
as if after long love they saw their beloved.

জন্মমাত্র বালক হইল যেই দেখা ।
কত কাল ছিল পুরুবের যেন সখা ॥ ৭৩ ॥

janmamātra bālaka haila yei dekhā |
kata kāla chila purubera yena sakhā || 73 ||

janma-matra balaka — the newborn child; haila yei dekha — whoever saw; kata kala chhila — had long been; puruvera yena sakha — as if a friend of old

73The child was just born — yet to those who saw Him
it seemed He had long been their friend of old.

প্রতি-অঙ্গে অমিয়া সঞ্চরে রাশি রাশি ।
নিরখিতে নয়নে হৃদয়ে কেনে বাসি ॥ ৭৪ ॥

prati-aṅge amiẏā sañcare rāśi rāśi |
nirakhite naẏane hṛdaẏe kene bāsi || 74 ||

prati-ange — from each limb; amiya sanchare rashi rashi — nectar flows in heaps; nirakhite nayane — when the eyes behold; hridaye kene basi — why do I feel so in my heart

74From each limb He pours nectar in heaps;
why, when the eyes behold [Him], does the heart [so stir]?

বালক দেখিয়া বুক ভরল আনন্দে ।
আলসিত আঁখি কেনে শ্লথ নীবিবন্ধে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

bālaka dekhiẏā buka bharala ānande |
ālasita āṁkhi kene ślatha nībibandhe || 75 ||

balaka dekhiya — seeing the child; buka bharala anande — bosoms filled with joy; alasita ankhi kene — why are the eyes languid; shlatha nivibandhe — loosened the knots of garments

75Seeing the child, [the women's] bosoms filled with joy;
why are their eyes languid, why have the knots of their garments loosened?9

জন্মমাত্র বালক দেখিল যেই ক্ষণে ।
কত কোটি কাম জিনি সুন্দর বদনে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

janmamātra bālaka dekhila yei kṣaṇe |
kata koṭi kāma jini sundara badane || 76 ||

janma-matra balaka — the newborn child; dekhila yei kshane — the moment they saw; kata koti kama jini — surpassing millions of Kamas; sundara vadane — with His beautiful face

76The moment the newborn child was seen,
His beautiful face surpassed millions of Kamas.

হেন অনুমানি সভে দেই জয় জয় ।
স্বরূপে মানুষ নহে শচীর তনয় ॥ ৭৭ ॥

sbarūpe mānuṣa nahe śacīra tanaẏa || 77 ||

77So reflecting, all cry "Jaya, jaya!
Shachi's son by His very nature is not human.

অভিনব কামদেব শচীর নন্দন ।
শ্রবণে অমৃত যবে করয়ে ক্রন্দন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

abhinaba kāmadeba śacīra nandana |
śrabaṇe amṛta yabe karaẏe krandana || 78 ||

abhinava kamadeva — a new Kamadeva; shachira nandana — Shachi's son; shravane amrita — nectar to the ears; yabe karaye krandana — when He cries

78Shachi's son is a new Kamadeva:
even His crying is nectar to the ears."

আপনে গোলোকনাথ কৈলা অবতার ।
নির্ধারিল নারীগণ অনুমান-সার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

āpane golokanātha kailā abatāra |
nirdhārila nārīgaṇa anumāna-sāra || 79 ||

apane golokanatha — the Lord of Goloka Himself; kaila avatara — has descended; nirdharila narigana — the women concluded; anumana-sara — the essence of their reflection

79"The Lord of Goloka Himself has descended" —
such was the conclusion the women reached.

সর্বলোকনাথ এ অবনী-পরকাশ ।
আনন্দে বিভোর কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৮০ ॥

ānande bibhora kahe e locanadāsa || 80 ||

sarvaloka-natha — the Lord of all worlds; e avani-parakasha — has appeared on earth; anande vibhora — beside himself with bliss; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

80The Lord of all the worlds has appeared on earth —
beside himself with bliss says this Lochana Dasa.

Raga mangala-gurjari; disha: "Rejoice, celebrate! In bliss, in Shachi's house, sing of Gora's virtues!"

*Mishra Purandara, overflowing with bliss —
his voice faltering —
summoning his kin and friends without delay,
celebrates the festival of his son's birth.*10

জয় জয় জয়, চৌদিগে সুখময়,
আনন্দে ভরল নগরী ।
কুলবধূ যত, আওল শত শত,
বিলাইল সিন্দুর পিঠালি ॥ ৮১ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa jaẏa, caudige sukhamaẏa,
ānande bharala nagarī |
kulabadhū yata, āola śata śata,
bilāila sindura piṭhāli || 81 ||

the town is filled with bliss;
all the wives of good families came by hundreds
and distribute sindura and pithali.11

পুত্র করি কোলে, আনন্দে প্রেমভরে,
গদগদ বোলে শচীদেবী ।
আশীর্বাদ কর, পদধূলি দেহ বর,
বালক হউ চিরজীবী ॥ ৮২ ॥

putra kari kole, ānande premabhare,
gadagada bole śacīdebī |
āśīrbāda kara, padadhūli deha bara,
bālaka hau cirajībī || 82 ||

putra kari kole — taking her son on her lap; anande prema-bhare — in bliss, full of love; gadgada bole shachidevi — Shachi-devi speaks falteringly; ashirvada kara — give your blessing; padadhuli deha bara — give the dust of your feet as a boon; balaka hau chirajivi — may the boy live long

"Give your blessing, give the dust of your feet as a boon —
may the boy live long!

বালক নহে মোর, আপন বলি বর,
দেহ না সব নারীগণে ।
অমিয়াধিক দেহ, পরিণাম বিপর্যয়,

deha nā saba nārīgaṇe |
amiẏādhika deha, pariṇāma biparyaẏa,
nimāi baliẏā thuila nāme || 83 ||

all you women!"
His body is sweeter than nectar; to ward off an evil outcome
they gave Him the name Nimai.12

এ অষ্ট-দিবসে, শিশুগণ-সন্তোষে,
এ অষ্ট-কলাই বিলাই ।

e aṣṭa-dibase, śiśugaṇa-santoṣe,
e aṣṭa-kalāi bilāi |
nabarātri mahotsaba, ānandamaẏa saba,

the "eight kinds of pulses" are given out;
the festival of the ninth night — all is bliss,
joyful music plays.13

বাঢ়য়ে দিনে দিনে, শচীর নন্দনে,
অবনী-পূর্ণিমার চান্দে ।
কাজরে উজোর, নয়ানযুগল,
গোরোচনা-তিলক-ছান্দে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

bāṛhaẏe dine dine, śacīra nandane,
abanī-pūrṇimāra cānde |
kājare ujora, naẏānayugala,
gorocanā-tilaka-chānde || 85 ||

badhaye dine dine — grows day by day; shachira nandane — Shachi's son; avani-purnimara chande — a full moon on earth; kajare ujora — bright with kajal; nayana-yugala — both eyes; gorochana-tilaka-chhande — a gorochana tilaka beautifully drawn

a full moon upon the earth;
His two eyes bright with kajal,
a gorochana tilaka beautifully drawn.

এ কর-চরণ, সঘন চালন,
ঈষত হাসয়ে মুচকি ।
শচী জগন্নাথ, দেখি অদ্ভুত,
নিরখে অনিমিখ আঁখি ॥ ৮৬ ॥

e kara-caraṇa, saghana cālana,
īṣata hāsaẏe mucaki |
śacī jagannātha, dekhi adbhuta,
nirakhe animikha āṁkhi || 86 ||

e kara-charana — the little hands and feet; saghana chalana — moves again and again; ishata hasaye muchaki — smiles ever so slightly; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; dekhi adbhuta — seeing the wonder; nirakhe animikha ankhi — gaze without blinking

smiling ever so slightly;
Shachi and Jagannatha, seeing this wonder,
gaze without blinking.

শ্রীঅঙ্গ-মার্জন, করয়ে নিতি নিতি,
সুগন্ধি-তৈল হরিদ্রা ।
বদন চুম্বয়ে, হিয়া ভরি থুয়ে,
ধন্য শচী সুচরিতা ॥ ৮৭ ॥

śrīaṅga-mārjana, karaẏe niti niti,
sugandhi-taila haridrā |
badana cumbaẏe, hiẏā bhari thuẏe,
dhanya śacī sucaritā || 87 ||

shri-anga-marjana — rubbing of the holy body; karaye niti niti — she does every day; sugandhi-taila haridra — with fragrant oil and turmeric; vadana chumbaye — kisses the face; hiya bhari thuye — holds to her heart; dhanya shachi sucharita — blessed is virtuous Shachi

87Every day she rubs His holy body
with fragrant oil and turmeric,
kisses His face and holds Him to her heart —
blessed is virtuous Shachi!

এছন দিনে দিনে, বাঢ়য়ে অনুক্ষণে,
আনন্দ নদিয়ানগরে ।
কিবা দিবা রাতি, না জানে বার তিথি,
প্রেমায় আপনা পাসরে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

echana dine dine, bāṛhaẏe anukṣaṇe,
ānanda nadiẏānagare |
kibā dibā rāti, nā jāne bāra tithi,
premāẏa āpanā pāsare || 88 ||

grows in the town of Nadia;
they know not day or night, nor weekday nor lunar day;
in prema they forget themselves.

নদীয়ানগরে, আনন্দ ঘরে ঘরে,
না জানি কি নারীপুরুষে ।

মাতল অতুল হরিষে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

nadīẏānagare, ānanda ghare ghare,
nā jāni ki nārīpuruṣe |
bāla bṛddha andha, prema-parabandha,
mātala atula hariṣe || 89 ||

nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadiya; ananda ghare ghare — bliss in every house; na jani ki nari-purushe — what to speak of men and women; bala vriddha andha — children, old men, the blind; prema-parabandha — bound by prema; matala atula harishe — drunk with matchless joy

what to speak of men and women:
children, old men, the blind, bound by prema,
are drunk with matchless joy.

শারদ-শশী জিনি, বদন অনুমানি,
মদন-সদনে বিরাজে ।
যুবতী যত ছিল, উমতি সভে ভেল,
ছাড়ল গুরু-গৃহ-কাজে ॥ ৯০ ॥

śārada-śaśī jini, badana anumāni,
madana-sadane birāje |
yubatī yata chila, umati sabhe bhela,
chāṛala guru-gṛha-kāje || 90 ||

sharada-shashi jini — surpassing the autumn moon; vadana anumani — the face, they fancy; madana-sadane viraje — shines as Madana's abode; yuvati yata chhila — all the young women; umati sabhe bhela — all went mad; chhadala guru-griha-kaje — left the household duties of their elders

Madana himself dwells in it;
all the young women, as many as there were, went mad
and left their household duties to their elders.

দিনে তিন বেরি, ধায় পুরনারী,
বালক দেখিবার তরে ।
দেখি দেখি বলি, সভে কোলে করি,

dine tina beri, dhāẏa puranārī,
bālaka dekhibāra tare |
dekhi dekhi bali, sabhe kole kari,
pulaka bharala kalebare || 91 ||

dine tina beri — three times a day; dhaya puranari — the women of the town run; balaka dekhibara tare — to see the child; dekhi dekhi bali — "let me see!"; sabhe kole kari — all take Him on their laps; pulaka bharala kalevare — their bodies thrill with rapture

to see the child;
"Let me see, let me see!" — all take Him on their laps,
and their bodies thrill with rapture.

এছন দিনে দিনে, প্রতি ক্ষণে ক্ষণে,
আনন্দ কহিল কি যায় ।

লোচনদাস গুণ গায় ॥ ৯২ ॥

echana dine dine, prati kṣaṇe kṣaṇe,
ānanda kahila ki yāẏa |
naraharidāsa, pada kari āśa,
locanadāsa guṇa gāẏa || 92 ||

Hoping for the feet of Narahari Dasa,

Thus ends the description of the Janma-lila.

Balya-lila (The Childhood Pastimes)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. When six months had passed, Gaurasundara's first feeding with rice and naming were performed according to rule; since with His appearance the whole world was filled with bliss, the wise named Him Vishvambhara. Gradually Vishvambhara, holding His father's finger, began to walk about the courtyard. Before the lustre of Gaurasundara's body, adorned with armlets, bracelets, a pearl necklace and other ornaments, the radiance of millions of moons grows dim. [The moon] can dispel only outer darkness, not inner darkness, but the moon of Gaura dispels darkness both outer and inner. Shachi-devi used to lull her son to sleep singing "Come, come, O moon, come" and other songs; at times she saw various gods and goddesses come and praise her son, and was greatly amazed. At times, seeing Gaurahari dance wildly with the gods, crying "Radha-Govinda", she fell senseless. At times she heard the sound of ankle-bells on His bare feet and was astonished; at times, fearing some coming misfortune, she became very anxious; and the next moment, seeing her son's face, she forgot everything and kissed His face again and again. When some time had passed in this way, Gaurasundara began to play outside the house with His playmates. When Shachi-devi tried to catch Gaurasundara, He would run away; and at times, growing angry, He would come home and spoil everything in the house. At times He explained to His mother the worthlessness of worldly notions of pure and impure and instructed her in the transcendental knowledge that Krishna is the Lord of all. Then are described: how He sat in a pit full of pots of leftover food and instructed His mother; how He struck His mother and, seeing her fall senseless, brought a coconut; various childish pranks; His play with a puppy; how Gaurahari, angry with His mother for letting the puppy go, wept; how the puppy, in a divine body, singing of Hari, went to Vaikuntha; how Brahma and others, seeing the puppy's good fortune, praised Gaura; how Gaurahari wept when Shachi-devi prepared an offering for the worship of Shashthi, and under the guise of words revealed to Shachi that He is the Lord of all.

Raga sindhura

এই মত দিনে দিনে শচীর কুমার ।
বাঢ়য়ে শরীর যেন অমৃতের ধার ॥ ৯৩ ॥

ei mata dine dine śacīra kumāra |
bāṛhaẏe śarīra yena amṛtera dhāra || 93 ||

ei mata dine dine — so day by day; shachira kumara — Shachi's son; badhaye sharira — the body grows; yena amritera dhara — like a stream of nectar

93So day by day the body of Shachi's son
grows — like a stream of nectar.

কি দিব উপমা তার দিতে নাহি পারি ।
খলবল করে প্রাণ কহিতে না পারি ॥ ৯৪ ॥

ki diba upamā tāra dite nāhi pāri |
khalabala kare prāṇa kahite nā pāri || 94 ||

ki diba upama tara — what comparison to give Him; dite nahi pari — I cannot give; khalabala kare prana — the heart trembles; kahite na pari — I cannot tell

94What comparison shall I give Him? I can find none;
my heart trembles — I cannot tell it.

নিতি ষোলকলা-পূর্ণ ইন্দু মুখচন্দ্র ।
সাধে দেখিবারে ধায় জনমের অন্ধ ॥ ৯৫ ॥

niti ṣolakalā-pūrṇa indu mukhacandra |
sādhe dekhibāre dhāẏa janamera andha || 95 ||

niti shola-kala-purna indu — a moon full in all sixteen digits every day; mukha-chandra — the moon-like face; sadhe dekhibare dhaya — run longing to see; janamera andha — those blind from birth

95His moon-like face is a moon full in all sixteen digits every day;
even those blind from birth run, longing to see Him.

আবেশে অধরে আধ মুচকি হাসিতে ।
অমিয়ার সাগর যেন হিল্লোল-সহিতে ॥ ৯৬ ॥

ābeśe adhare ādha mucaki hāsite |
amiẏāra sāgara yena hillola-sahite || 96 ||

aveshe — in rapture; adhare adha muchaki hasite — a half-smile on the lips; amiyara sagara yena — like an ocean of nectar; hillola-sahite — with rolling waves

96In rapture a half-smile plays on His lips,
like an ocean of nectar with rolling waves.

রসে ডুবুডুবু রাতা নয়নযুগল ।
কাজর-অমিয়া-পঙ্কে কে বান্ধ বান্ধল ॥ ৯৭ ॥

rase ḍubuḍubu rātā naẏanayugala |
kājara-amiẏā-paṅke ke bāndha bāndhala || 97 ||

rase dubudubu — drowning in rasa; rata nayana-yugala — the two red eyes; kajara-amiya-panke — with the nectar-mud of kajal; ke bandha bandhala — who built a dam

97His two red eyes are drowning in rasa —
who has built a dam of the nectar-mud of kajal?

শচী পুণ্যবতী জগন্নাথ ভাগ্যবান ।
সাদরে নিরখে দোঁহে পুত্রের বয়ান ॥ ৯৮ ॥

śacī puṇyabatī jagannātha bhāgyabāna |
sādare nirakhe doṁhe putrera baẏāna || 98 ||

shachi punyavati — virtuous Shachi; jagannatha bhagyavana — fortunate Jagannatha; sadare nirakhe donhe — both gaze lovingly; putrera bayana — at the son's face

98Virtuous Shachi and fortunate Jagannatha
both gaze lovingly at their son's face.

ক্ষণে হাসে ক্ষণে রোয়ে ক্ষণে খটি করে ।
ক্ষণে কোলে ক্ষণে দোলে হিয়ার উপরে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

kṣaṇe hāse kṣaṇe roẏe kṣaṇe khaṭi kare |
kṣaṇe kole kṣaṇe dole hiẏāra upare || 99 ||

kshane hase — now laughs; kshane roye — now cries; kshane khati kare — now frolics; kshane kole — now on the lap; kshane dole hiyara upare — now swings on the breast

99Now He laughs, now He cries, now He frolics,
now He is on her lap, now He swings on her breast.

শচী-স্তনযুগে দুটি চরণ রাখিয়া ।
দোলে যেন সোণার লতিকা বায়ু পাঞা ॥ ১০০ ॥

śacī-stanayuge duṭi caraṇa rākhiẏā |
dole yena soṇāra latikā bāẏu pāñā || 100 ||

shachi-stana-yuge — on Shachi's breast; duti charana rakhiya — planting both feet; dole — sways; yena sonara latika — like a golden creeper; vayu pana — catching the breeze

100Planting both His feet on Shachi's breast,
He sways like a golden creeper in the breeze.

অতি দীর্ঘ নয়ান সুন্দর অট্টহাসি ।
অধরে অমিয়া রাশি পড়ে যেন খসি ॥ ১০১ ॥

ati dīrgha naẏāna sundara aṭṭahāsi |
adhare amiẏā rāśi paṛe yena khasi || 101 ||

ati dirgha nayana — very long eyes; sundara attahasi — beautiful ringing laughter; adhare amiya rashi — heaps of nectar from the lips; pade yena khasi — seem to spill

101Very long eyes, beautiful ringing laughter —
nectar seems to spill from His lips.

নাসিকা শুকের ওষ্ঠ জিনি মনোহর ।
গণ্ডযুগ জ্যোতির্ময় গঠন সুন্দর ॥ ১০২ ॥

nāsikā śukera oṣṭha jini manohara |
gaṇḍayuga jyotirmaẏa gaṭhana sundara || 102 ||

nasika — the nose; shukera oshtha jini — surpassing a parrot's beak; manohara — charming; ganda-yuga jyotirmaya — both cheeks radiant; gathana sundara — the form beautiful

102His nose more charming than a parrot's beak,
both cheeks radiant, His form beautiful.

Notes

  1. A has "upon living beings"; the 1983 edition "upon me".
  2. That is, not gross-bodied. The Gaudiya Vaishnavas stress that the Lord's birth is not a worldly conception: the eternal Lord, full of knowledge and bliss, first enters the heart of the father, then of the mother, and reveals Himself, as Krishna does in the Bhagavata (10.2.16–18); cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 13.83–88).
  3. An elder brahmana bowing to a young woman and circumambulating her goes against custom; but Advaita is worshipping the Lord in her womb.
  4. A play on words in the praise: "Advaita" ("non-dual") and "Nityananda" ("eternal bliss") are both epithets of the Lord and names of His closest associates.
  5. "Gadadhara" ("holder of the mace") is a name of Vishnu; perhaps there is also an allusion to Gadadhara Pandita, Gaura's inseparable companion.
  6. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 13.89–98): the Lord appeared on the full moon of Phalguna during a lunar eclipse, when everyone, according to custom, was chanting the names of Hari.
  7. So after Bhaktisiddhanta's summary ("her house became Vaikuntha"); in A the line is corrupt; the 1983 edition has "in Shachi's womb the riches of the great Vaikuntha".
  8. Marks on the feet and body of a mahapurusha. The rendering of the last mark ("the elephant's kumbha", i.e. the frontal globe on an elephant's head) is tentative.
  9. Here and further on (vv. 59, 75, 90) Lochana Dasa describes the attraction of the women of Nadia to Gaura in the spirit of his nagari-bhava, in which Gaura is the nagara, the beloved of the townswomen. The Gaudiya tradition, following Vrindavana Dasa and Krishnadasa Kaviraja, does not accept worship of Gaura in such a bhava; Bhaktisiddhanta counts the "Gaura-nagari" among the deviant schools. We translate the text as it stands.
  10. In A this stanza is given in brackets together with the disha and is unnumbered; in the 1983 edition it is the first stanza of the song.
  11. Sindura is red powder, the mark of a married woman; pithali is rice paste for auspicious designs; they are distributed to women at a birth festival.
  12. The name comes from nim, the bitter neem tree: by custom a child is given a "bitter" name to avert misfortune and the evil eye. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 13.118), the name Nimai was given by Sita Thakurani to protect Him from witches.
  13. Ashtakalai — the distribution to children of eight kinds of pulses and grains on the eighth day after birth; on the ninth night, a festival with music.
